title: LOVE it !!!!!!!!
text: LOVE it !!!!!!!!. absolutely love it ... i stacked it with my other one that i had bought originally and move the K15 machine over  i like the way it looks  so this one holds 42 and the other 36 i think im good  :)  make sure though if you get it you push the little knob things into the track so the drawer doesnt fully come out and everything would go flying  it pops in very easily  i think it looks nice in my tiny little kitchen  i WISH i had more counter space  i had to get rid of my blender off the counter to accommodate all this
